title: 3.4 Vectors and Dot Products

icans: I can find the dot product of two vectors and use its properties.
I can find the angle between two vectors.
I can decide whether two vectors are orthogonal.

vocab: u · v = u₁v₁ + u₂v₂ (a number, not a __________)
